test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The ratio of money with Jack and John is 7 ∶ 13, and that with John and Jonas is 9 ∶ 11. If Jack has ₹6,300, then how much money does Jonas have?
solution: Given: The ratio of the money between Jack and John is 7 : 13. The ratio of the money with John and Jonas is 9 : 11. Jack has ₹6,300 Concept Used: The total amount of money can be found by equating the common ratio (Jack's money) and solving for the unknown. Solution: If Jack has 7 units, then 1 unit = ₹6300/7 = ₹900. John has 13 units, then John has 13 x ₹900 = ₹11700. If John has 9 units, then 1 unit = ₹11700/9 = ₹1300. If Jonas has 11 units, then Jonas has 11 x ₹1300 = ₹14300. Therefore, Jonas has ₹14300. 163:T708,
